acceptance.description: The realized operating point applies the FROZEN D6 law on the actual committed flow: pump hydraulic power rho*g*Q_actual*H(n,Q_actual), electric power pump/eta_total + no_load (so the energy later dissipated through the throttle is included in the electricity), useful system power rho*g*Q_actual*Hreq and throttle dissipation reported separately, pump = useful + throttle on every positive feasible flow, head/motor feasibility and the declared OFF/idle simplification retained, the frozen curve unreplaced and allocation and energy on the same law

The independent energy oracle does not call or consume any production realized_point/power/energy helper: it joins the committed physical discharge water records with the commanded speed by tick and binding, reconstructs the actual flow and evaluates H, Hreq, pump/useful/throttle power and electric energy directly from the frozen parameters, reproduces the ledger per pump, and both the capacity-Q substitution and the H-to-Hreq power substitution differ enough to fail acceptance

Regression: the accepted control correction stays green - protective ownership decided before normal PI integration, integral held from the first protected scan, actual stopped value committed and tracked, trip/interlock release preloaded from it, C1 release resuming through the ordinary slew from the actual last value (bounded ramp, not a bumpless claim), every ordinary reopening inside valve 10 pp/s and pump 5 pp/s, MANUAL and changed-PV continuity preserved

Regression: energy is still integrated only from the ACHIEVED pumped throughput of each tick (never from a capacity/envelope point), with OFF distinguished from energized zero flow and an explicitly declared idle-loss rule
Regression: 16 admitted scopes on deterministic global 1-second windows in one attempt-bound session with exactly two active C2 PI loops and the deferred loops unavailable
Regression: the full-run independent water identity still closes from tick zero with no created water and no compensation term
Regression: flow limiting and reservation semantics are unchanged (capacity tokens, no double count, queue bound, no hidden loss or deadlock)
Regression: the two PIs drive the real actuators with feasible SP tracking, disturbance rejection, saturation with a reason and recovery inside one ongoing attempt

Regression: pump envelope feasibility, OFF exactly zero flow and zero energy, unit-explicit energy and unmodelled energy declared unavailable, evaluated on REALIZED operating points under the corrected frozen power law
Regression: physical-envelope mutations still fail the oracle or fail safely
Regression: canonical X3 1 s default, X2-60s zero-C2 and G21 compatibility, deterministic reset/attempt/replay, no protected path changed
